claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

### Core Functionality (src/cycles.js)
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK` for weekly subscriptions
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to calculate weekly plans as price × 52 ÷ 12 a month, rounded to nearest cent
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly cycles by adding 7 days from the first charge

### CLI (bin/subtrack.js)
- Updated USAGE to show `--every week|month|year`
- Added "week" and "weekly" aliases to the EVERY object
- Updated error message for invalid cycles
- Updated SHARE_PER_MONTH to include weekly calculation for the total command

### Export (src/export.js)
- Added weekly calculation to the CSV export function

### Bug Fix (src/renewals.js)
- Fixed sorting to use date instead of shortLabel, which was causing incorrect ordering across month boundaries

### Tests (test/cycles.test.js)
- Added test cases for weekly cycle calculations
- Added test cases for weekly nextCharge calculations

## Features Verified

✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` adds weekly subscriptions  
✅ Weekly plans show correct monthly cost (€59.90/week = €259.57/month)  
✅ `subtrack renewals` lists weekly charges correctly  
✅ `subtrack list` displays weekly cycles properly  
✅ `subtrack total` includes weekly plans in monthly total calculation  
✅ `subtrack export` works with weekly cycles  
✅ Both "week" and "weekly" are accepted aliases  
✅ All 36 tests pass
